sources.name: University of Waterloo Events Calendar
sources.notes: Drupal iCal API export of the central campus events calendar - confirmed live 2026-08-26, 33 VEVENTs, DTSTART uses TZID=America/Toronto (local time, not UTC) which the generic ical parser handles correctly since it only treats a bare Z-suffix as UTC. This is the whole-campus calendar (research talks, job fairs, BioBlitz, inclusion/writing-cafe events), not international-student-specific - same noise-vs-signal tradeoff as Queen's central calendar in Kingston; keyword scoring will need to do the filtering. International student-specific events (International Orientation, Welcome Warriors) are promoted via the Portal Calendar after registration and were not independently confirmed reachable.

sources.name: Waterloo Public Library
sources.notes: Communico/libnet feed, confirmed live 2026-08-26 via GET https://wpl.libnet.info/eeventcaldata?event_type=0&req={...} - same libnet.info direct-domain pattern as Thunder Bay's TBPL, not a custom calendar.<lib>.ca subdomain.

sources.name: Region of Waterloo Library
sources.notes: Separate Communico feed covering the Region of Waterloo Library branches (Ayr, Baden, Cambridge-area, St. Jacobs, Wellesley, Elmira/Woolwich, New Hamburg/Wilmot) - complements WPL/KPL rather than duplicating them. Confirmed live 2026-08-26, same eeventcaldata pattern.

sources.name: Kitchener Public Library
sources.notes: Runs 'mylibrary.digital' (registration at kpl.events.mylibrary.digital) - a distinct platform from Communico/Mugo/GovStack, not yet seen in any other city onboarded so far. No JSON/ical route found on a first pass 2026-08-25 - registered probe. Given Waterloo and Region of Waterloo libraries already cover the region on Communico, this is a nice-to-have rather than a gap.

sources.name: Kitchener-Waterloo Multicultural Centre (KWMC)
sources.notes: 715 Fischer-Hallman Rd Suite 401, Kitchener - anchor settlement agency (forms, referrals, orientation, translation/interpretation, driver's licence and sponsorship help). Office: 519-745-2531, Mon-Fri 9am-5:45pm. No dated-events feed found - hand-enter workshops as announced.

sources.name: Reception House Waterloo Region
sources.notes: Community-based refugee resettlement organization - warm-welcome programs and services for government-assisted refugees. No dated-events feed found - hand-enter as announced.

sources.name: YMCA Immigrant & Employment Services (Kitchener/Cambridge)
sources.notes: Two locations: 800 King St W, Kitchener (519-579-9622) and 258 Hespeler Rd, Cambridge (519-621-1621). No dated-events feed found - hand-enter.

sources.name: Conestoga College - International (Doon campus)
sources.notes: Main Doon campus (Kitchener) - Conestoga has one of the largest international student populations of any Ontario college. Page reachable (200/302, confirmed 2026-08-26) but no calendar/feed found on a first pass - general info page only. Re-probe conestogac.on.ca/orientation or the student portal directly.

sources.name: Wilfrid Laurier University Waterloo - International Student Support
sources.notes: Main Waterloo campus (distinct student body from the Brantford campus already onboarded separately). Same events/workshops sub-page as Brantford's WLU entry - redirects/404s to automated fetches - confirmed 2026-08-26. Contact via the same students.wlu.ca International Student Support portal; needs a browser-rendering tool to find the real calendar route.

sources.name: City of Waterloo Events
sources.notes: Page mentions 'govstack' in its source (same eSolutionsGroup/GovStack family already confirmed unsupported for Brantford and Thunder Bay) - no feed found. City events (Lumen, Mayor's Oktoberfest Market) hand-entered in manual_events instead.

sources.name: City of Kitchener Events Calendar
sources.notes: Same eSolutionsGroup/GovStack platform, same appId (cid-v1:06dd76cf-d990-4513-9041-6103499b5b9b) as Brantford's city/library/tourism calendars and Thunder Bay's - a third confirmed tenant of this vendor, reinforcing that a centrally-added GovStack parser would pay off across many Ontario cities at once. /events 404s directly - try /events/month or /events/List if revisiting.

sources.name: Kitchener-Waterloo Festivals (hand-entered)
sources.notes: Lumen (light/art/tech festival, uptown Waterloo, Sept 19 2026), Mayor's Oktoberfest Market (King St, Waterloo, Oct 4 2026), and Ribs Rhythm & Rotary Ribfest (Aug 28-30 2026) hand-entered with confirmed 2026 dates. Waterloo Rib & Beer Festival (Jul 10-12), Kitchener Ribfest (Jul 17-19), Sun Life Uptown Waterloo Jazz Festival (Jul 17-19), Cambridge Ribfest (Aug 7-9), and Kitchener Blues Festival (Aug 6-9) had all already passed the 3-month build window at onboarding time - re-add for a build starting earlier in summer.

sources.name: Creekside Church - ISMC/FOCUS (International Student Ministries Canada)
sources.notes: The clearest spiritual fit found for this city - runs FOCUS, an explicit international-student/newcomer friendship ministry (also promoted as UWaterlooFOCUS on Facebook and at waterloointernationalstudents.com). Standing English Conversation Club Monday 9:30am (online) plus periodic Bible studies, no dated-event feed. Registered manual with an empty list per the no-recurring-events rule; contact Dorothy Tam, dorothy.tam@ismc.ca, 519-500-2218.
